requestedTarget.denominator: Current deployed compressed transport including required metadata and decoder overhead; raw-size comparisons reported separately

items.work: All native Model exports parsed to exact end; apply paired hidden lightmap mip regions while preserving geometry, collision, metadata and shadow masks. Reversible opaque-byte transforms and whole-Model Brotli remain research alternatives, not release requirements.
items.nativeValidation: Strict paired lightmap candidate passed controlled Rankin render/movement and combined normal menu→Rankin play→Tintagel render, with no native/page errors. This does not validate every map.
limits: Raw subcategories overlap Model total and must not be added to sibling totals.
Canonical BSP, collision and render-section geometry have not been reduced to 10% of current compressed transport.
Six largest-Model stream sample: byte/delta/bit shuffles were worse than Zstd; Brotli 11 saved about 22% on streams, not 90%, and broad Model regions overlap the new mip regions.
Cross-map 256/1,024/4,096-byte dictionary experiment did not beat the same sample Zstd baseline before required metadata/decoder overhead.

items.description: Row-padded 1-bit shadow raster arrays inside Model lightmaps
items.work: Exact Model grammar identifies 9,530,876 row-padded1-bit lighting-mask arrays. Lossless row/horizontal predictors and complete package framing were benchmarked; masks remain unchanged in selected strict candidate.
items.nativeValidation: No new shadow transform deployed or native-validated; selected Model mip candidate leaves all shadow bytes intact.

audit.rowStride: ceil(width/8) bytes per row; all 15,292 Rankin arrays matched. Native sampling bit operations were inspected.

limits: Whole-package savings were 0.65% / 0.33% before new decoder/parser overhead, not 90%.
A declared lighting bitmap is not permission to zero it; no lossy mask reduction or source stripping was applied.

items.description: Character and animation packages grow under current independent framing
items.work: Measure lossless framing/encoder changes separately from semantic animation encoding; no keyframe reduction assumed safe.

constraints: No content removal or collision changes merely to force a ratio
Original sources and currently deployed release remain intact until candidate validation
All missed categories are tracked even when an encoding is unsupported or unprofitable
Wire compression preserves native logical asset layouts; it does not imply corresponding reductions in native engine allocations.
accountingNotes: New semantic subcategories overlap their parent Model/instance totals; do not sum every item.
Raw serialized payload sizes are not compressed contribution sizes.
The 10% request remains unmet. Candidates are not shipped until native validation and release accounting pass.

intermediateCombinedCandidate.accounting: Unique active game-data files; excludes shell, original recovery, prefetch duplicates and HTTP headers.
